title: FDA-Cleared Rapid Resistance Test Landscape: a device-by-target dataset of rapid blood culture identification/resistance panels and rapid phenotypic susceptibility systems
description:
An open dataset of FDA-cleared and De Novo-authorized rapid molecular blood culture identification and resistance panels and rapid phenotypic antimicrobial susceptibility systems for positive blood cultures. For each device family it records organism and resistance targets, antimicrobial-organism indications, specimen type, and labeled limitations, including what a negative result does and does not rule out. Every row is traced to a 510(k) or De Novo number, decision date and page of the FDA source document. Includes derived comparison tables by target, organism and antimicrobial, a codebook, provenance log and validation scripts.

This is a regulatory-labeling reference, not a performance comparison.
